items.text: The Osprey unit has 14 campers aged 11 to 13 this summer.

Post the notice about the Osprey canoe morning to the parent bulletin by 18:00 on Wednesday 12 August.
The Osprey unit's regular lake swim sessions stay at the main dock with Marta and Ravi as the two lifeguards on duty.
Book six canoes from Pine Ridge for the Voyager unit's overnight trip on 18-19 September.

Submit seasonal staff contract renewals to the camp office. Not done yet.
